result.document_summary: A mid-document slice of the San Diego Municipal Code, Chapter 5, Article 2 (Divisions 30-33) covering drug loitering, ephedrine sales limits, clonazepam possession and synthetic drug definitions.
result.notes: This part of the document contains only public-safety provisions on drug-related loitering, ephedrine sales limits, clonazepam possession and novel psychoactive drug definitions. None of it concerns rent increase limits, just-cause eviction, security deposits, application or screening fees, tenant screening restrictions, or algorithmic rent setting. The source URL slug refers to a Division 11 ban on anti-competitive automated rent price-fixing (section 98.1103), but that text does not appear in this part, so no rule is extracted for it.
